title: Drag a task into another stage
description: On the task list, dragging a task into a different stage now changes its status and puts it where you dropped it. Before, a drag could only reorder within a stage or make a subtask.
items: Drop between two rows of a stage to put it there
Drop on a stage's heading to put it at the top — the way into an empty or collapsed stage
Stages a task cannot move to are dimmed while you drag it
A subtask dropped into another stage becomes its own task
Moves that need a note, such as sending client work back, still go through the status menu
